principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator.sum method uses type checking (isinstance) to calculate the area of different shapes. This approach means that every time a new shape type is added, you have to modify the sum method, which violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface or base class for shapes that includes an area calculation method. Each shape can then implement its own area calculation, allowing the AreaCalculator to call this method without modification.
